title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier Solid Brass Hardware Bathroom Storage | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized, space-saving storage to your bathroom with this wall mount glass shelf featuring three tiers and solid brass hardware. Designed to coordinate within the Carolina Collection, it complements transitional bathroom hardware and works well with versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Triple glass shelf / glass shelving helps keep toiletries and décor organized
- Wall mounted design makes efficient use of vertical space
- Thick, beveled-edge glass with solid brass hardware
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished installation
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
- Projection: 5.54 Inches
- Glass thickness: 0.38 Inch
- Product size (overall): 16 Inches (L) x 16 Inches (H) x 5.54 Inches (W)
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
